title: agent-surface
description: manifests/agent-surface.json — the operator-local agent surface commitwork installs and toggles: PreToolUse/Stop hooks, MCP servers and launch programs. A declaration read by bin/agent-surface.mjs; applying stays a human act. Every entry carries `why`, so a surface with no stated reason cannot be registered.

hooks.description: Keyed by the hook's registry name.

event.description: The harness lifecycle event the hook is attached to (PreToolUse, Stop, ...).

matcher.description: The tool-name matcher the harness applies before running the hook.

command.description: The command line, with $CW_ROOT for this checkout.

selftest.description: argv that proves the hook is live.

selftestExpect.description: The word the selftest must print.

mcp.description: Keyed by the MCP server's registered name.

launch.description: Keyed by the launch program's short name.

probe.description: A URL that answers when the program is up.
